title: Transfer: Triage Customer Signups Against a Sanctions Watchlist
goal: Screen new customer signup names against a sanctions watchlist containing aliases and transliteration drift, then write review-required hits with matched watchlist entities to /root/watchlist_hits.tsv.
skillBenefitRationale: This task shifts the skill into compliance screening, where fuzzy matching is required to catch alias-heavy or slightly misspelled entity names without relying on any other shipped skill.
